versions.changelog:
Initial release of alter-agent-channel: coordinate your own agent sessions across restarts and concurrent instances.

- Enables persistence and restoration of session state between agent runs.
- Provides advisory locks over files and branches for coordination.
- Supports issuing and claiming units of work between your own sessions and trusted daemons.
- Allows structured questions and responses to your own principal.
- Offers event stream subscribing and session roster visibility.
- All actions rely on your unique ALTER_API_KEY for authentication.
